content.value_statement: Financial statements can be hard to compare across periods and industries. This skill calculates ratios, interprets results, and summarizes financial health.
actual_capabilities: Calculates profitability ratios such as ROE, ROA, gross margin, operating margin, and net margin.
Calculates liquidity, leverage, efficiency, valuation, and per-share metrics from structured financial data.
Interprets selected ratios with benchmark ranges for technology, retail, financial, manufacturing, and healthcare industries.
Analyzes ratio trends when users provide multiple periods of historical values.
Generates concise financial health summaries and prioritized recommendations.
limitations: Requires accurate income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, and market data from the user.
Uses simplified benchmark ranges that may not match every company, sector, or market cycle.
Does not retrieve live prices, filings, or industry data from external services.
Provides analytical support, not investment, legal, tax, or accounting advice.

use_cases.title: Screen a Public Company
use_cases.description: Calculate core profitability, liquidity, leverage, efficiency, and valuation ratios before deeper due diligence.

use_cases.title: Review Credit Strength
use_cases.description: Assess leverage, interest coverage, liquidity, and trend signals from borrower financial statements.

use_cases.title: Prepare Finance Class Analysis
use_cases.description: Turn statement figures into ratio calculations, interpretations, and a clear written summary.

prompt_templates.title: Calculate Basic Ratios
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner analysis with one period of data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Calculate the main profitability, liquidity, leverage, efficiency, and valuation ratios from these financial statements. Explain each result in simple terms.

prompt_templates.title: Interpret By Industry
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these ratios for a technology company. Compare the results with relevant industry benchmarks and highlight strengths and risks.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Multi-Year Trends
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these three years of financial statements. Calculate ratio trends, identify improving and deteriorating metrics, and summarize the main drivers.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Investment Memo
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a financial analysis memo from these statements and market data. Include ratio tables, benchmark interpretation, trend commentary, and key diligence questions.

output_examples.input: A company has revenue of 1,000,000, net income of 150,000, assets of 2,000,000, and equity of 1,500,000.
output_examples.output: The company has a 15.0% net margin, 7.5% return on assets, and 10.0% return on equity. Profitability is positive, but returns are moderate.

output_examples.input: Current assets are 800,000, inventory is 250,000, and current liabilities are 400,000.
output_examples.output: The current ratio is 2.00 and the quick ratio is 1.38. Liquidity appears adequate, but inventory represents a meaningful share of current assets.

output_examples.input: Debt-to-equity rose from 0.8 to 1.4 over three years while interest coverage declined.
output_examples.output: Leverage is deteriorating. Review debt maturity, refinancing risk, cash flow stability, and management plans to reduce balance sheet pressure.

best_practices: Validate all statement labels, units, and time periods before calculating ratios.
Compare ratios with industry context and peer companies when possible.
Use trend analysis together with single-period results for a fuller view.
anti_patterns: Do not treat one ratio as a complete investment decision.
Do not compare companies with different accounting policies without adjustment.
Do not use stale market prices for valuation ratios.

faq.question: What financial statements does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, and market data fields supplied by the user.

faq.question: Can it analyze more than one period?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide historical ratio values or statement data across periods for trend analysis.

faq.question: Does it fetch live market data?
faq.answer: No. Users must provide share price, shares outstanding, and other market inputs.

faq.question: Which industries have benchmark support?
faq.answer: The scripts include simplified benchmarks for technology, retail, financial, manufacturing, healthcare, and general analysis.

faq.question: Can I use this with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks the skill as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is this investment advice?
faq.answer: No. It supports analysis and education, but users should apply professional judgment before making decisions.
